body.statement: After resolving the full-support product-mixture kill test, determine the explicit piecewise deterministic function \(\rho_n(d,\kappa,\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L)\), including the exact power of \(\log n\) on every critical equality surface, and construct the total data-based estimator \(\widehat\tau_n(0)\) from \(\mathrm{def:estimator\mbox{-}handle}\) such that \(c\rho_n\le R_n\le C\rho_n\) for every \(n\ge2\). Prove a necessary-and-sufficient partition of the primitive index space for \(R_n\asymp R_n^e\) versus \(R_n/R_n^e\to\infty\). At \(\kappa=0\), the frontier must reduce to the exact-uniform comparator slice in Theorem 3; for \(\kappa>0\), it must derive the new corner-zero regime, which is not contained in the comparator's bounded-overlap class. The result must not assume smoothness of \(\mathbb E_P[Y\mid X]\) or replace any full-class regime by an oracle submodel.
body.justification: The rate and the oracle-penalty partition are the theorem-level objects that quantify whether a smooth contrast remains estimable at its oracle difficulty when treatment vanishes locally and its multiplier is unknown.
body.gap: KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024MinimaxCATE gives the bounded-overlap frontier; Dorn2025WeakOverlapTStatistics studies average-effect inference and scalar regression; Kim2026RKHSPointwiseCATE retains a global overlap lower bound. None supplies this exact local-zero H\"older frontier.
body.consumer: The official \texttt{grf} causal-forest workflow estimates propensities and marginal outcomes and enforces treatment-balanced leaves; this frontier tells its users when local precision near a treatment-scarce boundary is information-theoretically possible and when stronger nuisance learning can change the rate.

obligation.what_is_open: For \(\alpha+\beta<\gamma\), derive a feasible higher-order data-only risk inequality on the exact class, its matching all-estimator lower bound, the resulting piecewise exponent and every critical logarithmic factor, and the necessary-and-sufficient oracle-penalty partition.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen core contains neither a proved higher-order projection inequality nor a fixed-\(n\) full-support mixture comparison. The candidate balance in the frontier handle is editorial evidence rather than a mathematical premise. Estimated-score centering, degenerate projection variance, propensity-dependent Gram stabilization, noninteger corner powers, and max-norm tie surfaces therefore remain uncontrolled on the full class.
obligation.attempted: I derived the first-order orthogonal score exactly, retained the distinct treated and control effective sample sizes, optimized its bandwidth, and combined it with a genuine same-propensity two-point oracle converse. I also tested the proposed higher-order route against the one-observation mixture algebra; that algebra leaves shared-sign cross-products in the product experiment and therefore cannot certify the conjectured exponent.
obligation.partial_result:
Let \(t=\min\{\gamma,\alpha+\beta\}\).  The proved oracle lower bound and the fact that an oracle estimator may ignore \(e_P\), together with the proved data-only first-order estimator, give the uniform all-regime bracket
\[
 c n^{-\gamma/(2\gamma+d+\kappa)}
 \le R_n(d,\kappa,\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L)
 \le C n^{-t/(2t+d+\kappa)},\qquad n\ge2.
\]
When \(\alpha+\beta\ge\gamma\), the two exponents coincide, so \(R_n\asymp R_n^e\) without a logarithmic loss.  For \(\alpha+\beta<\gamma\), this is an honest, generally nonmatching bracket; neither a rate penalty nor oracle attainment follows from it.
